questions.prompt: In which century did the American Revolution take place?
questions.fact: Roughly a fifth of the colonial population remained loyal to the crown, and many left for Canada afterwards.

questions.prompt: Which particle is found in the nucleus alongside protons?
questions.fact: A free one outside a nucleus decays within about fifteen minutes, which is why they are only stable when bound.

questions.prompt: Which country traditionally dominates the sport of sumo wrestling?
questions.fact: Despite being the national sport there, wrestlers from Mongolia have held the top rank for much of recent decades.

questions.prompt: Which actor played Neo in 'The Matrix'?
questions.fact: He reportedly gave away a large share of his fee to the visual effects and costume teams.

questions.prompt: Which mountain is the highest in Japan?
questions.fact: It is an active volcano that last erupted in 1707, and it is climbed by hundreds of thousands of people each summer.

questions.prompt: Which novel opens with the line 'It is a truth universally acknowledged'?
questions.fact: It was first drafted under a different title in the 1790s and heavily revised before publication some fifteen years later.

questions.prompt: Which storage medium was standard for music albums before CDs?
questions.fact: Sales collapsed almost to nothing by the late 1990s, then recovered to outsell CDs again in the 2020s.
